items.title: Louis Armstrong and Herman Chittison Interview, 1960-05-04

ctx.x: Well, now, Eddie, I live down in the alley. I live down in the alley. Well, I can't hear as I can be. Honey, I can be. Oh, my baby, I live down in the alley. That doesn't sound familiar to you. Well, now, Eddie, Eddie Haywood is on this label saying that he recorded with Sloppy Henry.
Yeah. Henry and Burr, Sloppy and Burr. See if this sounds like Haywood to you. Hey, we're singing, Jim. This is singing. Howdy. Howdy.
Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy. Howdy.
